_comment: Accepted pyscn clone groups. Purpose: make a NEW clone group a visible event.
The duplication sub-score is dominated by these accepted families, so it barely
moves when real duplication is added -- compare a weekly Code Health report
Groups are keyed by the SET OF FUNCTION NAMES they contain, not by line numbers,
so ordinary edits above a getter do not churn this file. Regenerate only when
adding or removing a getter from an accepted family, and say why in the commit.
These are NOT a backlog. Collapsing them means **kwargs and the loss of the typed
Measured with pyscn 1.29.0 on 2026-08-09, which compared docstrings: at
similarity_threshold 0.55 (default 0.65) it reported the same groups, and stripping
docstrings made duplication far worse (60 -> 0). pyscn 1.32.4 skips docstrings by
default (skip_docstrings below), so neither measurement applies to the pinned version.
Regenerated with pyscn 1.32.4 on 2026-10-13. Its default grouping (complete_linkage,
was connected) and min_lines (8, was 10) differ from 1.29.0, so it no longer reports
the NGWMN, NWIS, and WQP getter families and reports two small validator pairs instead.

groups.rationale: Shared argument checks (AGENTS.md, Error messages): each returns early when the arguments are valid and otherwise raises one message from the same parts. Each check owns its wording, so a common helper would only move the message apart from the check that states it.
NWDC selector validators: each strips a code, checks its digits and length, and raises a message naming that selector's own form and examples.
Water Data collection-family getters: ~30 explicitly typed parameters around a thin body. pyscn 1.32.4 skips docstrings, so the similarity is the parameter lists and bodies.
Water Data collection-family getters: ~30 explicitly typed parameters around a thin body. pyscn 1.32.4 skips docstrings, so the similarity is the parameter lists and bodies.

Two Water Data getters matched as a semantic (type-4) clone at 0.672, just above the 0.65 threshold. Expect this pair to appear and disappear between runs as either getter is edited; that churn is not a new clone.

sub_threshold_accepted._comment: Families that pyscn 1.29.0 did NOT report at its defaults (they sat under its min_lines=10 / min_nodes=20) but that a deliberate scan at min_nodes=8 found on 2026-08-09. Not re-scanned with 1.32.4, whose min_lines is 8. Recorded so they are not rediscovered and re-litigated. They are NOT counted in `observed` above.

groups.rationale: Deprecated NWIS getters (ADR 0005). The surface is frozen pending removal, so collapsing it buys nothing and churns a public API users are being migrated off.
